chunks: Ḥammād al-Laḥḥām narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Do not be lazy in seeking your livelihoods, for our fathers used to strive in it and seek it.

key_terms.مَعَايِشِكُمْ: your livelihoods and means of living

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teach about working to earn a livelihood?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers not to be lazy in seeking their livelihood. It presents the practice of the forefathers of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام as an example of actively striving and pursuing lawful means of living.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3576 - Hammad al-Lahham narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"Do not be lazy in seeking your livelihood, for our fathers used to strive for it and pursue it."
